name: Elemental Investiture
body:
School transmutation [see text]; Level adept 6, alchemist 6, druid 6, magus 6, shaman 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, witch 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 minute/level

DESCRIPTION

You wreath you body in elemental power, choosing between earth, fire, ice, or wind when the spell is cast. The spell gains the descriptor of the element chosen.

If you choose earth you gain the following:

DR 5/-.
You can move through difficult terrain caused by rocks or stone without a movement penalty and is treated as having spider climb active if moving on rock or stone.
You can cause a small earthquake 10 feet around you dealing 2d8 magic bludgeoning damage to creature in the area. The creatures must also make a Reflex save or be knocked prone.

If you choose fire you gain the following:

Immunity to fire and cold resistance 10.
You deal 1d6 fire damage to any creature that ends their turn within 5 feet of you.
You can fire a ray of fire as a ranged touch attack that deals 4d8 fire damage as a standard action on your turn.

If you choose ice you gain the following:

Immunity to cold and fire resistance 10.
The ground within 10 feet of you is considered difficult terrain and you are unaffected by difficult terrain caused by ice or snow.
You can fire a shard of ice as a ranged touch attack that deals 2d8 magic piercing damage and 2d8 cold damage as a standard action on your turn.

If you choose wind you gain the following:

A +10 bonus to AC against ranged weapon attacks and ranged natural weapon attacks.
You gain a fly speed of 60 feet (average). If you are flying when the spell ends, you drop.
You can create a 10-foot-cube whirlwind that deals 2d8 magical bludgeoning damage to all within. The creatures must also make a Fortitude save or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the center of the whirlwind.
